scope: Instrumented local smoke diagnostic, not formal qualification or live-model acceptance
findings: Root CLI stayed on native ACL worker backend; no PowerShell fallback is inferred from native/PowerShell counters and builtin binding readback.
Compare per-turn native-worker counts with growing lstat/open/read counts and input/HTTP/result phase timings before assigning cause.
Sampled cached-ledger-file reads resolve to EvolutionLedger.#matchesCachedFileWithIdentity -> #readPhysicalFileWithIdentity -> readBoundedDescriptor.
Directory attestation samples resolve to evolution-artifact-ports attestStoreDirectories and ledger #assertBoundaries.
limitations: Instrumentation adds overhead; timings are diagnostic and are not formal performance acceptance.
FS methods can call one another; duration totals overlap and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time.
FS callsite stacks are sampled once per 128 calls, with 24 retained distinct stacks per operation; counts are not exact caller distributions.
Captured native append logging can use wrapped Node fs internals; bounded per-result diagnostic IO is included in raw counters.
No payloads, tools, messages, or model bodies are recorded. The model endpoint is deterministic loopback fake Ollama.
